violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present at the beginning of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. ENFORCEMENT MAYBE WARRANT IF THIS CONTINUES

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed a bucket of murky water along the cook line. Upon discussion with PIC and staff, staff use the water to wash hands after dredging food in flour before frying.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC DISCARDED THE BUCKET OF WATER. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC AND STAFF TO WASH HANDS AT THE HAND SINK USING SOAP, HOT WATER, AND PAPER TOWELS. EHS SUGGESTED STAFF USE TONGS, STRAINERS, OTHER UTENSILS OR TOSS WITH A BOWL TO COAT FOOD IN FLOUR IF THEY DO NOT WANT TO GET THEIR HANDS DIRTY. DO NOT WASH HANDS IN A BUCKET OF WATER.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR prep top cooler, left side: fried eggplant was observed at 60f. Upon discussion with staff, eggplant was cooked 3 hours prior to inspection 2) in the walk-in cooler: chicken and noodle filling for spring rolls were observed at 44-48f 3) in the 1DR glass upright Pepsi cooler: brown rice (48f), white rice (47f), bib lettuce (45f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. STAFF AGREED TO DISCARD EGGPLANT IN 1 HOUR. PIC DISCARDED THE OTHER AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) house salad dressing
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE DRESSING.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Chicken and noodle filling for spring rolls were cooled in sealed containers overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO COOL THE SPRING ROLL FILLING UNCOVERED. EHS PROVIDED COOLING DOCUMENTS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) rice scoops were observed being stored in container of water. Water was observed at 71f 2) knife was observed being stored in between a prep top cooler and a prep table
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF AND PIC THE PROPER WAY OF STORING UTENSILS. UTENSILS WERE BROUGHT TO THE DISH MACHINE TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 1DR glass upright Pepsi cooler was observed at 45f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER TO STORE RICE, SALADS, BEAN SPROUTS, HOUSE DRESSING, ETC. UNTIL THE COOLER IS FUNCTIONING PROPERLY. COOLER WORK BEST WHEN THE INTERIOR TEMPERATURE IS 32-38f.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Adequate
violations.observation: Observed an accumulation of grease dripping off of the hood
violations.corrective_action: Ventilation hood systems and devices shall operate properly and be sufficient in number and capacity to prevent grease or condensation from collecting on walls and ceilings. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw chicken was being stored over cooked spring roll filling in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE CONTAINER OF RAW CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM SHELF

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) cooked sliced chicken was observed at 47f. Bowl of chicken was placed on top of the prep top containers 1 hour prior; 2) white rice was observed at 46-56f. Container of rice was placed on the countertop 4.5hrs prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE CHICKEN TO THE COOLER TO LOWER THE TEMPERATURE TO 41f. PIC DISCARDED THE RICE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed multiple jugs of various sauces being stored for more than 7 days on the top shelf of the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE SAUCES. USE OR DISCARD FOOD WITHIN 7 DAYS OF THE DATE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Two spray bottles of Raid, labeled for residential use, were observed being stored on the chemical storage rack.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE RAID. CONTACT A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR PEST CONTROL SERVICES.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed an employee wash a coffee pot in the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH AND SANITIZE DISHES AT THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK OR IN THE DISH MACHINE. PIC INSTRUCTED ALL STAFF TO USE THE HANDSINK FOR HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw shelled eggs being stored over Ready-To-Eat food in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF WITH THE OTHER RAW SHELLED EGGS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a can of WD-40 being stored next to an in-use rice maker.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE WD-40 TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed a box of personal medication being stored on a shelf next to food.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL MEDICATION TO THE EMPLOYEE LOCKERS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor of the kitchen and in the walk-in cooler and freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE FOOD OFF THE FLOOR. DO NOT USE WOODEN PALLETS. USE NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: Observed food being stored in various sized plastic storage totes and containers.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PURCHASE NSF APPROVED/FOOD GRADE STORAGE CONTAINERS.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. EHS observed employee rinsing gloves in the 3 compartment sink without following proper glove removal, handwashing, donning new gloves procedure.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS stopped employee, spoke to PIC and employee about proper handwashing procedure. Employee then proceeded to wash hands at the hand sink and used soap as required.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. EHS observed employees washing hands with gloves on in the 3 compartment sink, not at the designated handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS stopped employee, coached PIC and employee on where to wash hands. Employee proceed to wash hands in the designated handwashing sink.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. EHS observed rice cooling in the walk in cooler at 48F for longer than 6 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded rice that was temped at 48F

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: EHS observed on menus no disclosure statement for raw or under cooked ingredients such as steak/beef.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS spoke to PIC about issue. PIC agreed to fix consumer advisory disclosure statement on menu. EHS will follow up in 10 calendar days to verify compliance. Ensure menus state “steak can be cooked to order.” FINN THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/03/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. EHS observed retail sanitizer tablets being stored on the same shelf next to dry foods.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC moved sanitizer tablets so they were being stored away from food and consumables.

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia solution was measured at 500+ ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. PIC made sanitizer solution using tablets directly in the sanitizer buckets.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonia solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC was instructed to remake the sanitizing solution and was instructed to set up the large batch in the sanitize basin of the 3-vat sink before filling the red buckets.
